summary: Sharpened the latent-topology direction into a privacy-granularity question: trajectory-record-level DP protects record membership, whereas a shared latent interaction graph is a system/global property requiring a different neighboring relation. Added AISTATS 2023 distribution-privacy evidence and an instructor-ready minimal experiment scaffold.
termination_reason: The problem formulation became substantially more precise; next work should verify DP-SGD accounting and search for direct NRI/topology-privacy precedents rather than broaden the survey.
